name: Jackson's Automotive Repair
hook: Your customers on Route 9 get an honest $80 an hour and a master technician who explains the bill — that story deserves a page of its own, with the booking button right under it. Take a look:
fakt: you've been running a family-owned shop on Saratoga Road as an ASE-Certified Master Technician with over 20 years of experience, you're a NYS inspection station, you publish an $80 hourly rate with a $40 minimum and you already take bookings online
na_stronie: your name and phone, your own photos (the shop on Saratoga Road, both lifts, the welding bench, the front office), your seven services in your words — diagnostics for all makes and models, NYS inspection, car checks, oil and brake checks, breakdown service, tire change, battery change — your $80 labor rate, online booking Monday to Friday 7–5 and a contact form straight to your inbox
dlaczego: Someone searching for an inspection station or a straight labor rate near Saratoga should land on your shop and book the slot without calling while you're under a car. Every request goes straight to your email.
